Thus I corrected for χρονίζοντ᾽ ἄχη [lingering griefs]. Since τοὺς μέν [some] precedes and τοὺς δέ [others] follows, here it should have been said τοὺς δὲ χρονίζοντας ἐν μεταιχμίῳ σκότου ἄχη μένει [but for those lingering in the twilight of darkness, griefs remain]: but since the meter would not allow that, he changed the form of expression and said τὰ δ᾽ ἐν μεταιχμίῳ σκότου μένει χρονίζοντας ἄχη [but the griefs in the twilight of darkness remain for those lingering], which amounts to the same thing.

χρόνῳ: at some time, at length

Thus M and a few copies: in most it is ἐν βραχεῖ λόγῳ [in a short speech], which I have preferred. The error is in the opposite direction at Pr. 875, where M correctly has ταῦτα δεῖ μακροῦ λόγου [these things need a long speech], but several copies have μακροῦ χρόνου [a long time]. But at line 870 all have μακροῦ λόγου δεῖ ταῦτ᾽ ἐπεξελθεῖν τορῶς [these things need a long speech to be explained clearly].

where χρόνῳ πλέω [I sail in time] is corrupt, for which Hermann conjectured χρόνον πλέω [I sail for a time], which should have been πλείω χρόνον [for a longer time]. Valckenaer conjectured χρονουλκίᾳ [by prolongation of time].
But at line 1563 μένει δὲ μίμνοντος ἐν χρόνῳ Διὸς παθεῖν τὸν ἔρξαντα [it remains for the doer to suffer from Zeus in time while he remains], Schuetz corrected to ἐν θρόνῳ [on the throne].
